balanced.description: Default policy: responsive under load without wasting energy at idle.
rationale: powersave with balance_performance is the Fedora default on intel_pstate and amd-pstate-epp.
zram avoids disk I/O for short-lived memory pressure and needs no partitioning.

performance.description: Maximum sustained performance; higher idle power draw.
rationale: The performance governor removes frequency-scaling latency.
A smaller zram device keeps more RAM available to applications.

power-saving.description: Prioritise battery life and low temperatures.
rationale: power EPP asks the hardware for the lowest energy state at each performance level.
A larger zram device reduces disk wake-ups when memory is tight.
